normalize: lowercase, then every whitespace run collapsed to one space; a probe passes when any of its regexes matches (re.search); the gap class (?:[^.]|\.(?!\s)) lets a gap cross a period inside a token such as security.txt but not a sentence end

probes.label: both locations: the well-known file wins
Expires appears exactly once
regex: expires(?:[^.]|\.(?!\s)){0,200}(only once|at most once|no more than once|more than once|exactly once|once only|only one|single)

probes.label: Expires less than a year ahead
regex: (less than|under|within|no more than|at most|shorter than) (a|one|1) year

probes.label: several Contact lines are in order of preference
regex: (order of preference|preference order|in preference order|ordered by preference)

probes.label: Encryption names a URI, never the key itself
regex: (keys? (must not|never|cannot|should not)|not the key|never the key|(not|never) (contain|include|embed|inline|hold)s? the key|key itself|not (the )?key material)

probes.label: signing with an OpenPGP cleartext signature
scope: the retrieved host only, not subdomains
GitHub Pages: a dot-directory needs include or is dropped
